Roy Ziv-Nir, son of Debbie and Yoav, was born on 4 Tammuz 5766 (30 June 2006) in Hod HaSharon.

On 11 January 2026 he enlisted in the IDF and served in the Air Force.

Corporal Roy Ziv-Nir fell while carrying out his duties during the war on 26 Menachem Av 5786 (9 August 2026). He was twenty years old when he fell. He was laid to rest in the military section of the Neve Hadar cemetery. He is survived by his parents and siblings.
